list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Six Pr atoms form an approximately octahedral {Pr6(μ3-F)8} core: face-bridging fluorides and bridging trifluoroacetates connect the metal sites. Sodium ions link the anionic clusters into layers; axial sites bear water or trifluoroacetic acid.

synthesis.procedure: Praseodymium carbonate hydrate was dissolved in 90% trifluoroacetic acid at room temperature. A mixed aqueous NaF/HF solution was added (M+:Ln3+:F− = 1:3:4). The solution was kept in a phosphorus-pentoxide-containing desiccator at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The anion has a six-Eu, face-fluoride-bridged approximately octahedral core surrounded by bridging trifluoroacetates. Statistically disordered water and trifluoroacetic acid occupy an axial site; sodium links anions into cation–anion layers parallel to the bc plane.

synthesis.procedure: Europium carbonate hydrate was dissolved in 90% trifluoroacetic acid at room temperature, followed by mixed aqueous NaF/HF solution (M+:Ln3+:F− = 1:3:4). Crystallization proceeded in a phosphorus-pentoxide-containing desiccator at room temperature. The same reaction yielded two morphologically distinct europium crystal phases, IIa and IIb.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The {Yb6(μ3-F)8} anion has bridging trifluoroacetates and partially disordered ligands; one Yb site has coordination number eight rather than nine. Potassium ions connect the hexanuclear anions into infinite chains along the crystallographic b axis.

synthesis.procedure: Ytterbium carbonate hydrate was dissolved in 90% trifluoroacetic acid at room temperature. Mixed aqueous potassium fluoride/HF solution was added (M+:Ln3+:F− = 1:3:4), and the solution crystallized in a phosphorus-pentoxide-containing desiccator at room temperature. The compound-specific subsection denotes the potassium fluoride as KF.
